steps.title: Analyze App Requirements
steps.description: Establish the design architecture of Harmony Player using standard high-performance Android SDK features.

steps.title: Create Application Metadata
steps.description: Generate app-meta.json with standard package declaration com.harmonyplayer.app.

steps.title: Configure Build Settings
steps.description: Configure app/build.gradle using AGP 8.3.2, SDK 34, Temurin 17, with no external dependencies.

steps.title: Design App Manifest
steps.description: Setup AndroidManifest.xml with necessary permissions for storage scanning, foreground service, and launcher configuration.

steps.title: Create Custom Drawables
steps.description: Create background gradients, circular glowing buttons, and seekbar templates to achieve a breathtaking interface style.

steps.title: Build Main Layout XML
steps.description: Create activity_main.xml layout utilizing dynamic section views, visualizer display, standard list, and EQ controls.

steps.title: Implement Song Model Data
steps.description: Implement Song.java to model audio tracks, duration, isDemo, and cache locations.

steps.title: Implement Audio Visualizer View
steps.description: Create VisualizerView.java to draw mathematically smooth dynamic color gradients responding to song beats.

steps.title: Implement Synth Sound Generator
steps.description: Develop WavGenerator.java to mathematically synthesize 3 tracks (Neon Horizon, Retro Lullaby, Cosmic Whispers) as pristine WAV files on device startup.

steps.title: Implement Music Background Service
steps.description: Create MusicService.java to handle MediaPlayer lifecycle, foreground state, audio focus loss, and status broadcasts.

steps.title: Implement Main Activity Controller
steps.description: Write MainActivity.java to bind to MusicService, scan media, search, toggle favorites, trigger sleep timer, and adjust virtual equalizer sliders.

steps.title: Building Harmony Player
steps.description: Perform final gradle assemble compilation step to compile resources and produce debug APK.
